summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for schools and libraries. The comments express support for preserving E-Rate funding and infrastructure, emphasizing its importance for education and technology access.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would require cutting student academic support positions
claims.evidence_quote: Mount Notre Dame High School has received $58,231 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $11,646 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
